CustomField.label: Lost in last 12 months
CustomField.description: SCRUM-461: rolling twelve-month window on CloseDate (the date the deal was lost). House pattern Wartungsvertrag_Renewal_Soon__c with ADDMONTHS - the report metadata has no rolling 12-month interval. Deals without CloseDate are outside the window and are not retro-fixed. System-computed, read-only.
